lines.japanese:
微苦笑（久米正雄）、空想（森鴎外）などと同様、本稿管理人による造語。
　意図的に稚気を含ませて笑うこと。
　戯れ笑う。ざれわらう。などから送り仮名が省略されたもの。
lines.english: “Playlaugh”: a coinage by this site’s administrator, after Masao Kume’s “faint bitter smile” and Mori Ogai’s “fantasy.” To laugh with deliberate childishness. In Japanese, its written form drops the kana endings from expressions meaning “to laugh playfully.”
Feel free to use it without permission.
